TNK PROGRESSION — 1.1.2

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge 21.1.262 · Java 21

A quieter screen by default. The character HUD now starts hidden, with a configurable modpack default and the existing per-player toggle.

HUD hidden by default

  • The character HUD is now off by default for new players and existing characters who have never selected a HUD preference.
  • Added the top-level "hudEnabledByDefault": false setting to config/tnkprogression.json. Pack authors can choose the default without changing individual player data.
  • Existing configuration files receive the new setting automatically while retaining their existing settings.

Player control and saved preferences

  • Players can still open Character with I and use the HUD: Hidden / HUD: Shown button.
  • Explicit show/hide choices remain saved and take priority over the pack default, including an existing choice to keep the HUD visible.
  • Changing the HUD default preserves character levels, XP, origins, Ascension, titles and skill points.

Installation notes

  • Update Progression on both client and server to 1.1.2.
  • For a hidden default, keep hudEnabledByDefault set to false. Existing players who explicitly enabled their HUD can hide it through Character.
  • The Unidentified Loot 1.1.3 and Spiral Abyss 2.0.5 compatibility added in 1.1.1 is retained.

Validation: 41 automated tests passed. Focused dedicated-server checks confirmed configuration migration, the hidden default, explicit player overrides, saved preference persistence and unchanged character progress. The existing direct-XP and Ascension server checks also passed. No graphical client playtest was performed for this small preference change.
